description: Pinned real-world Ada/GPR projects used for extraction regression testing (burndown 5.3). Refs are commit SHAs, not branches, so results are reproducible across CI runs. Bump refs deliberately and refresh scripts/corpus_baseline.json in the same commit.

projects.name: gpr2
projects.notes: Large real GPR/project-model codebase. Its .gpr needs a generated .build/kb directory (from gprconfig_kb, produced by a build step we don't run here), so this falls back to the auto unit provider over all sources rather than a specific .gpr. Already used in spike 1.5 (with a real build present, that run resolved a 345-file subset via the project graph directly).

projects.name: adasat
projects.notes: Small SAT solver; repo has multiple .gpr files (testsuite included), so the main project is pinned explicitly. Already used in spike 1.5.

projects.name: libadalang-tools
projects.notes: Medium-size, dogfoods Libadalang itself. Its .gpr files `with` unvendored deps (e.g. templates_parser) that aren't resolvable without Alire, so this falls back to the auto unit provider over all sources rather than a specific .gpr.

projects.name: alire
projects.notes: Larger real-world application (the Alire package manager CLI). Its .gpr files `with` unvendored Alire-managed dependency crates, so this falls back to the auto unit provider over all sources rather than a specific .gpr.

projects.name: libkeccak
projects.notes: Small SPARK-flavored crypto library; exercises SPARK aspects (D-006 scope). Its top-level .gpr `with`s a generated config/libkeccak_config.gpr, so this falls back to the auto unit provider over all sources rather than a specific .gpr.
